propositions: Canonical `rebar bridge status` and hidden `bridge-status` must expose identical read-only status with zero mutations, shared parser, and identical verdict/exit contracts.
Process finalizer writes minimal authoritative JSON to `refs/reconciler/last-pass` before releasing the lock, with exactly three CAS attempts, 100/200 ms backoff, and loud failure on exhaustion.

Status reads last-pass with optional detail file, pause state, and live lock OID/fence/lease; total precedence is PAUSED > RUNNING > FOREIGN > FAILED > STALE > HEALTHY with NEVER_RUN only when both record and lock absent.

Canary defaults to durable `status` source after one producer write, performs two read-only lock snapshots to detect stalled fences as CRASHED, and preserves github-api explicit rollback for one release.
Local identity is `local:<repo-env-id>` from `.env-id` (explicit `REBAR_ENV_ID` wins); missing/empty/.env-id is a hard error; inbound metadata and LEGACY_JIRA_ENV_ID remain unchanged.
ADR 0094 documents the authoritative ref, rolling detail, write-before-release order, CAS classifier reuse, and extends ADR 0031 live-fence/lease-blob precedent with exact numbering convention.
